_comment: Per-string context pushed to Crowdin by `npm run i18n:context`. One line per key saying where the string appears and what constrains it — the facts a translator cannot get from the English alone. Written when the string is, by whoever ran /wording. Keys mirror en.json.
title: Title of the settings dialog.
language: Label of the language row in the settings dialog. The value beside it is the language's own name and is not translated.
cancel: Settings dialog button, discards changes. One word.
account.row: Label of the account row in the settings dialog, which opens the account view.
account.title: Title of the account view. Replaces the dialog's own title, so it must read as a heading on its own.
